name: Alamo Group, Inc.
summary:
Alamo Group (ALG) reported earnings of $2.82 per share on revenue of $450.73 million for the second quarter ended June 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $2.74 per share on revenue of $441.27 million. The company beat consensus estimates by 2.92% while revenue grew 7.55% on a year-over-year basis.

Alamo Group Inc is engaged in the design and manufacture of agricultural equipment and infrastructure maintenance equipment. Its products include tractor-mounted mowing and other vegetation maintenance equipment, among others.
subject: Alamo Group Beat Consensus Estimates
